title: Sally Ann Hansor
clean_html:
Sally Ann Hansor

Preserved Primary Document • hansr-s1.htm

Around 1849, she married Benjamin Durham and moved to Jolley's Neck Farm. As a Hansor, Sallie Ann was probably descended from William Hansor, the original owner of Jolley's Neck as was her husband Benjamin. The known children of Benjamin Durham and Sally Ann Hansor were : Daniel Durham (1849-1931) married Caroline Carney Annie Durham (1855-1912) married John Durhan John M. Durham (1856-1933?) married Elmira Morgan Harriett Durham (1858- d. before 1880) Enoch Durham (1858-1921) married Margaret Munce and Lola Miller Jeremiah Durham (1862-1936) married Lydia Munce Henrietta Durham (1865-1934) married Napoleon B. Morgan Amanda Durham (August 1867-1940) married #1 Mitchell Sammons #2 Coursey Sammons #3 Charles Johnson Henry Durham ( 1869-1870) Clement Durham (1872-1947) married Rebecca Munce Mariah "Minnie" Durham (1873-1921 ) married Shadrick "Sherry" Carney (1870-1933) Harvey Durham (18 March 1876- ) married Lola Durham On 1 September, 1888, Benjamin Durham died. Sally Ann died on 11 November, 1905. Her death certificate lists her age as 81, her race as Moor and the cause of death as old age & general debility. Both are buried behind the church at Fork Branch, on land that originally belonged to Jolley's Neck.
